verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows a first-party rule engine where users define event-triggered automatic actions. The Events API only lets you retrieve activity for a SIEM. The CLI, SDKs, Connect and service accounts are developer building blocks for scripting, and Watchtower only flags issues; none of these is a user-defined trigger-action rule capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
